description: Documentation: network-design design.md v3.15 -> v3.16 (design section 9), retrain-prereqs design.md v1.4 note recording how review v1.3's findings were implemented, and the draft report .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/report.md (the full-suite numbers are filled in by the integration step). Depends on FEAT-001..005 (documents what they built).
steps: Edit .agents/tasks/network-design/design.md (it already has an uncommitted 1-line change; keep it): status line v3.16 (2026-10-26) with a one-paragraph summary pointing to .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/design.md; section 4.7 planned skip schedule marked 'implemented (retrain-prereqs)' with the semantics of retrain-prereqs design 4.1 (independent draws per stage/task/step, skip 4 keeps level 2 running on un-pre-warped inputs, skip both = identity); replace the v2 'Level skipping' sentence 'The decision is made once for the whole group and applies to both linear and deformable cascades.' with 'One draw per stage, per task and per step, shared by the whole group (a group is never split); linear (rigid, affine) and deformable draws are independent.'; 5.2 optimizer: AdamW decision and that --weight-decay never acted on Adam; 3.2/3.3 augmentation: --lowres-method tent (TF only) with the centroid table of retrain-prereqs 3.1; 5.x: the one-run level-4 schedule (delayed deform start) and the sweep; milestones table: a 'retrain from scratch' row (prerequisites done, runs pending).

Edit .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/design.md: status v1.4 and a section 15 'v1.4 (implementation of review v1.3)' entry: F1 BUDGET/fits rule (MiB, numbers) in the r_level4/r_level2 headers; F2 shrink percentages corrected to '0.4-4 % and 4-33 % (lr 1e-4 to 1e-3)' in 2.1; F3 deform-only task-start gating; F4 'died before start' failed state; F5 --time from smoke step_time x 1.3 and --c-time help; F6 VAL_GROUP_SIZE = min(16, DEFORM_N_small); F7 non-finite skip wording in 1 and 2.3. Apply the F2 and F7 text corrections in place.

Write .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/report.md (concise): what was built per deliverable (AdamW, tent low-res, per-stage skip, delayed start, scripts/sweep/summarizer), the exact local verification evidence from FEAT-001..005 findings (targeted test counts, goldens max |diff| 0, e2e result from e2e_level4.txt), a placeholder section 'Full suite' to be filled by the integration step, what is NOT verified locally (RTX 8000 / A100 memory and step times at the new N, login-node python3 version, real-data AdamW / one-run schedule behaviour, m10 placeholders N/DEFORM_N), and the orchestrator hand-off: fill N/DEFORM_N from scratch/m10/memory_batch.json with the fits rule, then commit/push/pull, smoke commands per script, sweep commands (`python3 slurm/sweep_level4.py list|submit --phase A`), open question for Jay: wd grid {0, 1e-2, 1e-1} vs his {0, 1e-5, 1e-4} (one flag away: --wds 0,1e-5,1e-4) and 'tent' instead of 'area'.
acceptance_criteria: network-design design.md shows v3.16 with the listed section edits
retrain-prereqs design.md shows v1.4 with the review-v1.3 implementation notes and corrected F2/F7 wording
report.md exists with deliverables, evidence, unverified items and exact hand-off commands; no secrets, no cluster actions performed
verification: Read back the three documents and check every cross-referenced flag name exists in runtime/args.py (python main.py --help in WSL bgr_preproc38 lists --cascade-skip-linear, --cascade-skip-deform, --task-start-step, --task-start-ramp-steps, --lowres-method)
findings: DONE (no git, no cluster). (2) .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/design.md -> v1.4: status line; F2 corrected in place in 2.1; F7 corrected in place in section 1 (AMP row) and 2.3; section 15 'v1.4 (implementation of review v1.3)' entry F1-F7 (F1 notes that the section-6 '46000 MB' wording is superseded; grep confirms no r_level script contains 46000). (3) .agents/tasks/retrain-prereqs/report.md (draft): deliverables table, per-FEAT evidence (test counts, goldens max |diff| 0, e2e from e2e_level4.txt), 'Full suite' placeholder for the integration step, not-verified list, hand-off commands (capped memory job, fits rule, smokes per script, sweep list/submit/status + summarizer), decisions section (wd grid and tent are already CONFIRMED by Jay per design 16, so stated as resolved rather than open).
